name: http.request
title: Http Request
description: Make an arbitrary HTTP(S) request (any method, headers, and body) and return the status, response headers, and body. Use this for APIs and raw protocol access; to read a web page as a readable document prefer `web.fetch`. Private/loopback addresses are blocked unless the `web` egress scope grants them. A header value may be a secret reference `{"$secret": "ENV_NAME"}`, resolved from the environment and never shown — but only for env-var names the operator has allowlisted; any other name is refused.
